title: Lead Leak Check input

pipelineDescription.title: Pipeline description (plain English)
pipelineDescription.description: Where leads come from, where they are stored, who replies and what alerts exist. Example: 'Leads come from a Typeform and WhatsApp into Google Sheets via Zapier on the free plan. Nobody is assigned. ChatGPT drafts replies. No error alerts.' If all three inputs are empty, a built-in sample pipeline is analysed (free demo report).
pipelineDescription.prefill: Leads come from a Typeform and WhatsApp into Google Sheets via Zapier on the free plan. Nobody is assigned; Slack pings #sales. ChatGPT drafts replies. No error alerts.

pipelineConfig.title: Pipeline config (JSON, optional)
pipelineConfig.description: Structured config for exact results. Keys (all optional): name, sources[], storage, routing, response, monitoring, automation, timezone, follow_up. See README.

runHistoryCsv.title: Run-history CSV (optional)
runHistoryCsv.description: Paste a Zapier/Make/n8n run-history export with a header row. Needs a status column; a timestamp column enables gap and stale-workflow checks.

expectedIntervalMinutes.title: Expected minutes between runs (optional)
expectedIntervalMinutes.description: Used with the CSV. If empty, the typical gap in the CSV is used.

description: Describe your lead pipeline in plain English, paste a JSON config, or paste a run-history CSV (any combination). Each filled field = one risk report. If you leave everything empty, the Actor returns a free demo report for a built-in sample pipeline.
